title: helichrysum roseum
intro: Helichrysum roseum, commonly known as the Rosemary Leaf Helichrysum or False Rosemary, is a perennial herb in the daisy family. It is native to South Africa and has been traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. The plant is rich in health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and anxiety, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Helichrysum roseum include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation.
